name: freshness-four-read-only-opens
body: `is_fresh` performs up to five separate read-only `db.lbug` opens on the no-live-session path — the pending-state probe, the schema-shape diff, `db_recorded_scan`, `seed_authored_identity`, and `tree_authored_identity`'s internal `PreviousScan::capture` — each taking its own handle rather than sharing one (the `.four-` half of this note's name is superseded). It is a pre-scan gate today; upgrade to a single shared read-only handle if freshness ever becomes hot, or if the probes must observe one consistent snapshot.
